title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：penguin　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 penguin 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the keeper ① fed the penguin that no child in the zoo would have recorded, and he said the feeding was the whole of the season. The ② penguin, meaning the bird itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a penguin, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ penguin in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ penguin at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A penguin, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the penguin was the whole of the matter, meaning the grace and not the bird. The ⑥ penguin, meaning the grace and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; penguin, he said, is either something you feed or the only word that means both a bird and a grace. He said the grace is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ penguin had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ penguin of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of recording; penguin, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ penguin I remember is the bird recorded in the register, which closed in 1959 and is still recorded as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ penguin, my mother said in 1961, is the only bird that improves by being recorded; every penguin, she said, is a grace that has agreed to look like a bird. She said the grace was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 企鹅（指兽舍里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 企鹅（指那只企鹅本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：feed the penguin 喂这一只企鹅
D. n. 企鹅（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 企鹅之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的企鹅之事）
F. n. 企鹅（指饲养台账里写到、被记载的那一只）
G. n. 企鹅、憨态（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 憨态（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fed the penguin that no child in the zoo would have recorded
The penguin, meaning the bird itself and not the fence
the penguin at the far shed
the penguin was the whole of the matter
the penguin had become a line in a register
The penguin of the whole thing
A penguin, my mother said in 1961

answers.why: feed the penguin 意为“喂这一只企鹅”，1952 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯记载的一只企鹅做了一遍。
penguin 意为“企鹅”，指那只企鹅本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记载。
penguin 意为“企鹅”，指兽舍里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
penguin 意为“企鹅”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
penguin 意为“企鹅、憨态”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只憨态就是那件事的全部。
penguin 意为“憨态”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只企鹅，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
penguin 意为“企鹅”，指饲养台账里写到、被记载的那一只，到 1957 年这一只成了饲养台账里的一行。
penguin 意为“企鹅之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的企鹅之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的记载。
penguin 意为“企鹅”，我记得的是饲养台账里记载过的那一只，1959 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一只。
penguin 为抽象总称，母亲 1961 年说，企鹅是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的企鹅。

最远那间棚舍那只企鹅，指的是他们留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（penguin）
